issues.message: Top/bottom resistances are complete paths to ambient and add to explicit surface boundaries. Avoid overlapping paths. Each object has one temperature; surface labels do not create a spatial field. Constant power/properties, prescribed convection and radiation to fixed surroundings; no PCB spreading, airflow, or radiation view factors are computed.

provenance.method: damped Newton heat balance; backward-Euler transient integration
provenance.radiation_model: gray body to fixed large surroundings, view factor one
provenance.resistance_interpretation: Complete independent top/bottom paths to the specified ambient; missing sides are adiabatic.

example_assumptions.power: Illustrative constant Q1/Q2/Q3 losses, not measured or extracted from PI.
example_assumptions.thermal_paths: Illustrative complete effective component-to-board and board-to-ambient resistances; no copper spreading, airflow, or spatial temperature field.
example_assumptions.heat_capacity: Illustrative constant lumped heat capacities, not derived from mass and specific heat.
